subject: Eval asset provisioning playbook and handoff timeline for BrightRetail POC
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@brightretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@brightretail.com>, dataops@brightretail.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Eval asset exchange + MAP for BrightRetail POC

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency and cost tradeoffs you showed. Our next step is a short POC: we want to load a sample of our anonymized customer queries and run Redwood inference with two prompt packs and a small test harness.

Can you send over a Mutual Action Plan and the logistics for exchanging: (1) a 5k-row evaluation dataset (anonymized), (2) a prompt pack with negative/positive testcases, and (3) the test-case harness? Key constraints from our side:
- Data must be used only for evaluation and not retained beyond the POC window (we require deletion certs).
- Tests should run in your hosted environment or a dedicated sandbox; we cannot send raw PII.
- We need a target close timeline (two-week POC preferred).

Please include any required NDAs/MPAs and the upload method (S3 presigned or secure portal). Marcus from Legal is looped for the MPA / redlines.

Best,
Lara

--
Lara Chen
Director, Data Science
BrightRetail

[attachment: brightretail_sample_manifest.csv (csv, 3 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@brightretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Eval asset exchange + MAP for BrightRetail POC

Hi Lara — appreciate the clear ask. Attaching a short MAP (draft) that maps milestones, deliverables, owners, and the close timeline. High level proposal:
- Day 0: Sign MAP & MPA (standard Redwood eval license)
- Day 1: Secure upload by BrightRetail via presigned S3 (we can provide short-term encrypted bucket)
- Day 2–3: Ingest & sanity checks by Redwood (schema + anonymization validation)
- Day 4–8: Two prompt-pack runs, baseline + variant (we'll run noise tests and measure recall/latency)
- Day 9: Joint review session (30–45 min)
- Day 10: Deletion cert + final report; decision to expand or close

I attached the MAP draft and a sample prompt pack stub. Our default is hosted-sandbox for rapid turnaround; if you require private VPC, we can scope that but it will add ~1 week.

Key usage constraints we propose in the MAP (open to redlines):
- Evaluation-only license: assets and outputs used solely to evaluate model performance for this POC and associated procurement discussions.
- Retention window: 90 days from handoff unless otherwise agreed in writing.
- No redistribution, derivative dataset retention, or use for model training without explicit permission.

Attachments: BR_MAP_draft_v1.pdf, prompt-pack-v1.zip (stub).

I can schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon to walk through.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

[attachment: BR_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@brightretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@brightretail.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval asset exchange + MAP for BrightRetail POC — redlines and handling notes

Hi all,

Thanks for the MAP draft (Karthik). A few legal/ops redlines from our side before we sign:
- We need explicit confirmation that the uploaded sample contains no direct identifiers and that BrightRetail has performed k-anonymity checks; please include the brief anonymization checklist in the manifest.
- Change the retention window to 90 days with an option for earlier deletion; require deletion certification from RedwoodOps when completed.
- Add a clause that Redwood will not use the dataset for model training or benchmarking outside of this POC; any analytics on outputs are aggregated and only for debugging.
- For the upload we prefer a presigned S3 + server-side encryption with KMS; do not share public URLs.

Operational notes:
- We'll provide an ingest report within 48 hours of upload and flag any schema issues.
- Prompt-pack exchange should be zipped and checksummed. Please keep testcases as examples and mark any production-derived prompts so we can ensure no leakage.

Attached: MAP_redlines_BrightRetail.docx with line-by-line comments.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

[attachment: MAP_redlines_BrightRetail.docx (docx, 18 KB)]

From: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@brightretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@brightretail.com>, dataops@brightretail.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval asset exchange + MAP for BrightRetail POC — redlines and Qs

Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks — we reviewed the redlines and are broadly comfortable. A few items before we sign:
1) Escrow: can Redwood hold the dataset in escrow for the 90-day window and provide a deletion cert? If not, we will keep the master and rely on your deletion cert after you run the tests.
2) Isolation: our security team wants runs to execute in an isolated tenant with network egress controls (no outbound S3 writes except to the agreed results bucket).
3) DocuSign: send over and we'll have legal sign the MAP/MPA.

We put together a short list of test-case expectations in the attached manifest; these are high-level so you can scope the harness.

Marcus Holt
General Counsel, BrightRetail
marcus.holt@brightretail.com

[attachment: brightretail_test_expectations.md (md, 5 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@brightretail.com>, Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@brightretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, dataops@brightretail.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval asset exchange + MAP for BrightRetail POC — final timeline and handoff plan

All — good progress. Confirming the agreed plan and next steps so we have a single record: 
- DocuSign: Marissa will send updated MAP (with your redlines) via DocuSign today (target signature by EOD Wed).
- Upload: BrightRetail to upload anonymized 5k-row CSV to our encrypted presigned S3 (we will email the link after DocuSign completes).
- Isolation: Redwood will run tests in a dedicated sandbox tenant with egress restricted to the results S3 bucket and no external logs retained beyond aggregate metrics.
- Retention & deletion: Redwood commits to deletion within 72 hours of POC close and will provide a deletion certificate signed by RedwoodOps within 5 business days.
- Timeline: once signed, target 10 business days from upload to delivery of the joint report.

A couple operational asks from our side: please include an anonymization checklist in the manifest and attach checksums for the prompt-pack zip. Also confirm preferred contact for run-day troubleshooting (we recommend a single technical contact + a fallback).

I'll kick off a 30-min run-day prep call for Thursday; calendar invite to follow. Looking forward to getting this over the line.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[attachment: prompt-pack-v1.zip (zip, 1.2 MB)]
